name: Ruvindu Gunasekara
description: Ravindu is a former national cricket canada player who brings in his vast experience in international arena to WCA. He will be working closely with members to improve performance.

name: Dhanuka Pathirana
description: Dhanuka is a former national cricket canada player who brings in his vast experience in international arena to WCA. Danuka has also played for Sri Lanka A. He will be working closely with members to improve performance.

name: Trevin Fernando
designation: London Ontario Leagues Captain | Junior Coach
description: Trevin is a former under Sri Lanka under 20 player and currently professional cricketer. Trevin is the captain appointed to lead the WCA. Trevin will also be working with junior cricketers to shape up their cricketing futures in Canada.

name: Ravindu Mahanama
description: Ravindu brings a unique blend of professional discipline and sporting passion to our academy. With over 5 years of experience in the software industry and his current role as an Assistant Operations Manager, he understands teamwork, strategy, and leadership at a deep level. A dedicated all-rounder with years of cricketing experience, Ravindu is committed to helping players develop both their technical skills and game sense.

name: Samudu Wijesinghe
designation: Junior assistant Coach & London Premier League  Mentor
description:
A lifelong cricketer, Samudu began his journey at age 12 and proudly captained Kingswood College (Sri Lanka) at U13, U15, U17, and U19 levels. Now based in London, Ontario, he plays an important role at Western Cricket Academy by:
	•	Assisting in structured coaching and training sessions
	•	Mentoring youth in skill, discipline, and character development

	•	Supporting strategic match planning and player performance
	•	Leading community and school outreach programs

Samudu’s leadership and international cricketing background help shape a strong, positive future for our academy players
